function.name: add_task
function.description: Adds a new task to the user's todo list.

function.name: view_tasks
function.description: Views all tasks in the user's todo list, with an optional status filter.

status.description: The status to filter tasks by.

function.name: update_task
function.description: Updates the description of an existing task.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update.

new_description.description: The new description for the task.

function.name: mark_task_status
function.description: Marks a task as complete or pending.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update.

status.description: The new status for the task.

function.name: delete_task
function.description: Deletes a task from the user's todo list.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to delete.
